lens: clock: stakes or skips by hour band and weekday (PROTOCOL_V3 Addendum I), in sample only
data_rule: price rows ts < 2022-01-01 (pyarrow filter at read); official trades entry_time < 2022-01-01 in the read; nothing 2022+ read, simulated or looked at
account: PLAIN SUM of the ten sleeves' one-position chains (P0 convention of synthesis_B): each sleeve one position at a time, 3-spread refusal, trades still open at the end of the slice dropped, no cap across sleeves; stake = 1 R x the variant's multiplier, no compounding. Kept the same throughout.

measure.book: trades of the ten chains whose fill time is in [2019-01-01, 2022-01-01) UTC, each counting multiplier x R, booked at the FP server week (Monday-Sunday, server = New York + 7 h) of its exit
measure.weeks: every server week whose Thursday is in 2019, 2020 or 2021 (157 weeks), empty weeks = 0; per year: the weeks of that year
measure.weekly_sharpe: mean / standard deviation (ddof 1) of the weekly sums x sqrt(52)
measure.equal_swing: the variant's stakes are multiplied by k = sd(reference weekly R) / sd(variant weekly R) over the 157 pooled weeks (fp and stress each against its own reference); reported at that scale: total R, share of losing weeks (weekly sum < 0, all weeks counted), worst week, longest run of losing weeks, max drawdown of the weekly curve, losing trades per month (trades with multiplier > 0 and R < 0 over 36 months), weekly Sharpe (scale-free)
measure.reference: the same book with every multiplier = 1

first_check.rule: ten sleeves rebuilt from in-sample slices, FP costs, one position at a time, compared with the official rows entered before 2022 (counts from entry/exit times only; results on the rows closed before 2022; the one trade each of donch4h_stop and orb_asia_2d_buf10 still open on 2021-12-31 is closed in 2022 in the official file and its result was not read)

bands.time_of_a_signal: start of its FILL bar (entry_time of the trade; for an order never filled there is no trade). Market-entry sleeves fill 0-5 minutes after the decision; the two gold stop-entry sleeves (donch4h_stop, orb_asia_2d_buf10) at the touch, which is known when it happens (a robot that emulates stop entries at market decides the stake at the touch).
bands.hour_band_rule: equal-length parts of the sleeve's window of decision times: 3 parts for windows of 12 h or less, 4 parts (quarters of the New York day) for 24 h sleeves; lower bound included, upper excluded; orb on the London clock because its window is set in London time
bands.weekday: day of week of the fill time on the FP server clock (New York + 7 h), Monday..Friday
bands.untouched: GOLD_FRI_PM__xauusd keeps stake 1 in every variant (one time, one weekday)

part1.persistence_note: sleeve-folds = sleeve x out-of-fold year where the fit acts; 'folds_in_expected_direction' = training-worst cell below the rest of the sleeve the next year (best: above); diffs in R per trade

O1_Horacle.rule: for each sleeve with hour bands and each year Y in 2019-2021: multiplier of band b = clip(mean R of the sleeve chain trades of band b in Y / mean R of all its trades in Y, 0, 2) when that sleeve-year mean is > 0, else 1; the chain is not re-simulated (multiplier 0 kept as a zero stake)

X1_autopsy_half.rule: fixed multiplier 0.5 (no fit) for: every fill at or after 12:00 New York (all sleeves but GOLD_FRI_PM, which stays untouched as declared); nq_btc_follow fills from 09:30 to 09:47 New York (decisions 09:30-09:46); Friday fills (server weekday) of ocm4 and of the five crypto sleeves; a trade in several cells gets 0.5; everything else 1

X2_infold_HDhalf.rule: the rule of P8_HDhalf (worst hour band and worst weekday at 0.5 when their training mean <= +0.02 R) fitted ONCE on every reference chain trade closed before 2021-12-25 (including 2019-2021) and applied to every year: in-fold, look-ahead by construction

X3_autopsy_skip.rule: X1 with multiplier 0 (orders removed, chains re-simulated one position at a time with the 3-spread refusal)

trials.correction_note: per-year Sharpe of stage A and C first split by entry year (late-December trades exiting in the next year's first week dropped from both years); recomputed on the weeks of each year; pooled figures unchanged; no verdict changed

verdict: no candidate: no walk-forward clock stake or skip raises the portfolio's weekly Sharpe at equal swing on 2019-2021; the best of the nine declared rules is x1.000 (a rule that never acted) and the others x0.933-x0.995; perfect foresight of each year would give x1.18 (hour bands) / x1.38 (weekdays), but random labels give as much (null medians x1.22 / x1.41); even the autopsy's own clock cells applied on the years they were found in give only x1.011-x1.028 (fp)
to_be_said: found on the years that built the rules: optimistic; the measure that counts is the validation look, then the demo account
